name: brset
license: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data License 1.5.0 (Research only)
citation: Nakayama et al., 'A Brazilian Multilabel Ophthalmological Dataset (BRSET)', PLOS Digital Health 2024. doi:10.1371/journal.pdig.0000454
notes: Requires PhysioNet credentialed-user account + CITI training + signed Data Use Agreement. Set PHYSIONET_USERNAME and PHYSIONET_PASSWORD in .env to auto-download.

name: mbrset
license: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data License 1.5.0 (Research only)
citation: Nakayama et al., 'A Mobile Brazilian Retinal Dataset (mBRSET) captured with a portable handheld fundus camera', Scientific Data 2025. doi:10.1038/s41597-025-04627-3
notes: Same PhysioNet credentialed flow as BRSET. Modality EyeDataHub otherwise lacks (portable smartphone-based fundus).

name: harvard_fairvision
full_name: Harvard-FairVision (AMD + DR + Glaucoma, paired SLO + OCT)
citation: Luo et al., 'FairVision: Equitable Deep Learning for Eye Disease Screening via Fair Identity Scaling', arXiv 2310.02492; Harvard Ophthalmology AI Lab 2024.
notes: Application-gated (Harvard form). No automated mirror. Sub-repos: github.com/Harvard-Ophthalmology-AI-Lab/Harvard-{AMD,DR,Glaucoma}.

name: oct5k
citation: Morano et al., 'OCT5k: a dataset of multi-disease and multi-graded annotations for retinal layers in OCT images', Scientific Data 2024. doi:10.1038/s41597-024-04259-z
notes: UCL Research Data Repository — Figshare-backed, free download.

name: mario
notes: Distributed as 21 multi-part split zips (Task_1.zip.001-014 + Task_2.zip.001-007, ~21.8 GB). After download, reassemble with `cat Task_1.zip.* > Task_1.zip` then extract with 7-Zip.

name: multieye
citation: MultiEYE: OCT-Enhanced Fundus Multi-Disease Benchmark, IEEE TMI 2025; arXiv:2412.09402
notes: Re-aggregates several source datasets — image licenses inherit from their original sources. Verify per-component before reuse.

name: uwf_zhejiang
full_name: Open UWF Fundus Dataset with Disease + Quality Labels

name: uwf_dr_peng
full_name: UWF Fundus DR Dataset (Peng et al., 2026)
citation: Peng et al., 'A UWF fundus DR dataset with senior-ophthalmologist labels', Scientific Data 2026. doi:10.1038/s41597-026-07093-7

name: rop_ostrava
full_name: Retinal Image Dataset of Infants and ROP (Ostrava)
citation: Timkovic et al., 'Retinal Image Dataset of Infants and ROP', Scientific Data 2024. doi:10.1038/s41597-024-03409-7

name: rop_uwf_intelligent
full_name: Fundus Dataset for Intelligent ROP System
citation: Zhao et al., Scientific Data 2024. doi:10.1038/s41597-024-03362-5

name: fovea
citation: Ravasio et al., 'FOVEA: paired pre- and intra-operative fundus + biomicroscopy', Scientific Data 2025. doi:10.1038/s41597-025-04965-2
notes: Unique pre-op/intra-op paired modality — only public example.

name: hpmi
citation: Huang et al., 'HPMI: A retinal fundus image dataset for identification of high and pathological myopia based on deep learning', Figshare 2024. doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.24800232.v2

name: csdi
full_name: CSDI: Cataract Severity Diagnostic Image Dataset
notes: First public fundus dataset with paired professional cataract reports. HF dataset requires `huggingface-cli login` (HF returned 401 on unauthenticated audit 2026-07). Mirror at github.com/rainyNighti/CSDI.

name: slid
license: See repo (no LICENSE file as of 2026-06; assume research-only)
citation: Xu et al., 'SLID: Slit-Lamp Image Dataset', Frontiers Digital Health 2025. doi:10.3389/fdgth.2025.1716501
notes: Modality EyeDataHub otherwise lacks (slit-lamp anterior-segment). Annotations CSV is at github.com/xumingyu-hub/SLID/raw/main/Annotations.csv.

name: eyecare_100k
license: Mixed (inherits source-dataset licenses) — needs per-row check
notes: Status: PENDING RELEASE. Largest open ophthalmology VQA corpus when published. EyecareGPT models are out (LLSuzy/* on HF) but the VQA dataset itself is not yet public as of 2026-06.
